verdict.text: All eight mismatches the plan lists are still real against today's code, and each is fixed the way the eval row asks.
Decision records get a dated Correction added at the end, and no earlier text is changed.
The architecture page and the two how-tos are edited directly.
HOOK_DESCRIPTION changes only after a check that nothing matches on its text.
Every claim the change adds holds against the code.
The extra fixes for pre-existing issues are accurate too.
I found nothing that needs another round.
Gates: I ran `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree.
Lint, format, tests, integration, r2 and r3 all passed, with stamp green e6526ff3690b18667bd08fcb3a8c83f88443bd739a60e4240f18627aa8d95939.
I also ran `prek run okf-validate --all-files` (okf validate --strict) and `prek run kmctl-check --all-files`, and both passed.
`kmctl review due` does not list the summary.
`kmctl briefing` reports "summary current".
r1 (judgment), checked item by item against the code: ADR 0014.
`apm/apm.yml` depends on okf-skills, `./claude` and `./antigravity`.
`apm/.apm/` holds only `agents/kmctl-auditor.md` and `skills/`.
The rules sit in `apm/claude/.apm/instructions/`, and `apm/antigravity/.apm/instructions/` holds the copy that `scripts/sync_antigravity_rules.py` writes.
pyproject's force-include matches the three folders the Correction names.
`kmctl plugin --help` lists only `patch`.
doctor's `_lock` builds the id `{harness}.lock`, so `claude.lock` exists, and it compares `resolved_ref` with `package_ref()`.

The test claims also hold: `tests/test_plugin.py` tests the shipped hooks and the MCP launcher, `tests/test_plugin_patch.py` uses fake uvx and claude and asserts `fakes.calls("uvx") == []`, and both files carry `@pytest.mark.integration` tests against APM 0.33.0.
`APM_FILES` is the four files the Correction names, `current` refuses when any one differs from `MANIFEST`, and `set` pins `APM_DOC` and moves the `kmctl_ref` default in `COPIER`.
The `_agents` folder is used by `antigravity.agents_dir`, which `opencode.py` imports.
The `_rules` folder is used only by `opencode.py`.
Both match the Correction.
The paths are right, and the 2026-10-17 correction it refers to exists.
Overview.

The `okf.py` importer list matches what grep finds for `from kmctl.okf` in `src/kmctl/`: checks, concepts, docs_index, handoffs, review_due, scaffold, summary, supersede and verify, plus kinds (`ALLOWED_FIELDS`).
The text on `action/agent.py` matches its docstring and ADR 0017.
The mermaid edge now says release.py writes the four files.
How-tos.
`.agents/plugins/kmctl/` is `antigravity.PLUGIN_PATH`.
The three Antigravity hooks match `package_hooks("antigravity")`, which lists SessionStart, PostToolUse and Stop.
Dropping "`main` until then" is right now that v0.9.0 exists.
HOOK_DESCRIPTION.
Outside `.loop/spikes` output, only `doctor._claude_hook`, through `hook_entry()`, and `tests/test_plugin.py`, through the constant, use its text.
The new wording matches what `kmctl briefing` prints: the routing, the skills, the state and one reading rule.
The concern about doctor's `claude.hook`: doctor compares the whole entry, description included, so a settings.json written by an older package now fails `claude.hook`.
In that case the CLI and the package versions differ, so `claude.lock` already fails with the same fix, an update.
Under ADR 0026 the pinned CLI runs doctor, so the CLI and the package match in the normal case.
`_is_kmctl_hook` finds kmctl's hook by its command, so `plugin patch` still finds and replaces an older entry.
This is acceptable.
ADR 0014's front-matter description still names `kmctl plugin install --harness`.

The record keeps its original text, the Amended notes and the new Correction carry the change, and the line for 0014 in `.okf/decisions/index.md` already says "(amended by ADR 0020 and ADR 0021 ...)".
Leaving the description as it is follows the never-rewrite rule, so this is acceptable.
Beyond the plan: the release.py docstrings and help, the release.yml header and PR body (its `git add` line stages all four apm.yml files), and the how-to's three hooks are all accurate.
The test_apm_package change keeps the three skeleton sections as a strict prefix and lets only `Correction, YYYY-MM-DD` headings follow.
The test needed this change because ADR 0014 now has a Correction section.
None.
The overview says `action/agent.py` "needs nothing from kmctl".
That is true of the script, which imports nothing from kmctl.
Audit mode still installs kmctl and sets KMCTL_PINNED so the agent's skills can run kmctl commands.
The wording matches the script's own docstring, so this is not a finding.
Merge: main's release-cache-off also appends to `.okf/log.md` and changes `checked` in `.okf/summary.md`.
Expect conflicts there when merging.
Keep both log lines, and re-acknowledge the summary.
The commit message has no "left alone" items to name, because all eight were real and are fixed.
